method: Real local Chromium; real UI actions, shared-origin parallel student tabs and browser print/PDF
limits: Fictional students and browser storage; no server authorization or cross-device synchronization.
No physical devices or printers tested.

checks.name: Teacher login opens the assigned roster in both designs
Two student tabs learn independently and populate the correct roster progress
Selected-student grading, automatic groups and parent messages remain separate
Selected-student JSON and print/PDF contain the correct name and clear on roster return
Search, class filter, no-result recovery and keyboard student selection work
Both roster designs fit five viewport sizes with usable controls
Reload restores separate reports; reset clears only the selected student
No script errors or failed images during roster and student management flows
